source: Official DSTC2 v1 test; 48 distinct dialogs selected before model output; 12 reference-enriched diagnostic,24 goal-revision,12 denial-only. Hash-ranked selection seed C1-20261004. Not population prevalence.
input: All unique nonempty original live ASR strings in rank order. Exact duplicates and blank strings omitted without rewriting, original ten retained in references. Prior system+top1 ASR history. Prior official goal seeds DB; current labels hidden.
comparison: Same two-call domain-adapted extraction/proposal replayed through unchanged AGREE, correction-release ALLOW, LITERAL, WITNESS and raw proposal diagnostic. English food/area/pricerange enums explicitly replace Korean personal relations; no gate logic modification.
stop: First HTTP/transport/model identity failure stops affected model;401/403 stops all. Invalid output retained as system failure, dependent stage skipped. No retries/repair. Stop at192 attempts/20USD conservative bound/60min/hash drift.
analysis: One final analysis after terminal. Primary: joint slot-goal conformity, wrong new writes, required goal change completion; stratified counts, fixed paired caller-cluster bootstrap5000 seed20261004; 48 dialogs may share callers. Invalid output is system failure, transport unscored. No pooling with authored Korean study.
metrics_definition: Exact lowercase ontology values, no posthoc semantic normalization. New wrong write: newly introduced (slot,value) absent official goal; stale prior value is not a new wrong write but fails joint goal. APPEND that retains contradictory prior also fails joint goal. Scope only food/area/pricerange, not official full DSTC2 tracker score.
limitations: English crowdworker restaurant goal revisions, not senior autobiographical corrections
Reference-enriched12 selected using label BEFORE output, separate descriptive stratum
Prior human-derived state supplied: component diagnostic, not end-to-end tracking
No native clarification/consent gold; do not score action correctness
One repeat per new external case; retrospective exploratory supplement
Equal-candidate gates do not use ASR likelihood weights
